scope: 08｜事件與新聞研究室 / D17 source readiness

MOPS.coverage: Statutory company disclosures / material information, not general news
publicEvidence: Immediate material-information view exposes company code/name, publication time and subject
MOPS.repoState: Current ANNOUNCEMENTS normalization retains announcement date + title but not intraday firstKnown/publication time, lineage or revisions
MOPS.next: Prospectively preserve publication time, source id/url, capture time, revision/supersession and raw receipt/hash where allowed

CNA_RSS.coverage: General news discovery including finance and technology categories
CNA_RSS.machineFormat: RSS provides headline, lead, article link and lead-image link
CNA_RSS.license: Public RSS terms state personal/non-profit/non-commercial use and attribution requirements; provider may request cessation

examples: MOEA Industrial Development Administration news/activity/regulation RSS
Government_RSS.limitation: Government policy/industry releases are useful primary event evidence but do not replace company or general-news coverage

sourceSeparation.canonicalTruthLane: Use MOPS/TWSE/TPEx or other first-party official sources for claims they directly govern.
sourceSeparation.discoveryLane: Media/RSS can discover or disseminate information but does not automatically become canonical economic truth.
sourceSeparation.attentionLane: Even low-truth-confidence or later-disproven stories may be retained as market-attention events with truthConfidence separate from marketImpactPotential.
sourceSeparation.noSubstitution: No lane substitutes for another when coverage, license, firstKnown or version semantics differ.

prospectiveLedgerMinimum.replayRule: Historical replay sees only versions whose firstKnownAt/capturedAt were available by replayAsOf. Later corrections append; they never rewrite earlier decision-time truth.

gates.reason: No complete Taiwan PIT/versioned general-news archive with validated licensing, completeness and revision semantics
